# Move keyboard focus to the first missing detail after save

## What & Why
Inline messages identify missing details, but keyboard users still have to find the first invalid field manually after a failed save. Moving focus to the first missing field would make recovery faster without changing what gets saved.

## Done looks like
- Failed answer saves focus the title first, or the answer content when only content is missing
- Failed opportunity saves focus company first, or role when only role is missing
- Focus remains inside the open dialog and works with screen readers
